span.p:
1. Sources
XLS/XLSX reports, BIP PDFs/CSVs,
source manifest

2. Import
research:import_sources
licenses, operators, raw locations,
streets and SIM population

3. Normalize
research:normalize_locations

span.p:
4. Geocode
research:geocode_open

plus manual review decisions

research:prepare_zenodo_repository
